scenes.speaker: CAPT
scenes.text: Mayday mayday mayday. This is Cactus fifteen thirty nine. Hit birds. We've lost thrust on both engines. We're turning back towards LaGuardia.

scenes.speaker: ATC
scenes.text: Cactus fifteen forty nine, it's gonna be left traffic for runway three one.

scenes.speaker: CAPT
scenes.text: We can't do it. We're gonna be in the Hudson.
